_provenance.reference: imsg status/initialize readiness snapshot, quoted in https://github.com/steipete/imsg/blob/main/docs/rpc.md ('status'), with bridge.ready false as on a default install.
_provenance.note: Transcribed from published docs, NOT captured from a live Mac. The claim under test is that 'typing' and 'read' appear in methods even with bridge.ready false -- the documented exception to the injected-helper requirement, which is what lets a default install (SIP untouched) show a typing indicator. Their PARAMETER lists are undocumented, so the client disables each permanently on first rejection rather than trusting this.
